prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error even though JSON response mode never streams SSE. prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 replaces the check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that correctly handles HTTP content-negotiation semantics: per-entry q-value parsing (excludes q=0 entries), case-insensitive type/subtype splitting, and wildcard matching. #2046 instead swaps the two .includes('application/json')/.includes('text/event-stream') substring checks for a similarly simple substring-based acceptsJson check, which doesn't parse q-values or media-type structure and remains vulnerable to false positives from substring matches (e.g. within vendor media types) and false negatives from quality-0 exclusions. #1996's approach is the more spec-correct fix for the same bug.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 replaces the single-slash-strip with a normalizeDiscoveryPath helper (equivalent regex fix to #2214's) in buildWellKnownPath, and additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback's root check from pathname === '/' to pathname === '' — needed because the pathname reaching that function is already stripped upstream, so the old '/' comparison was dead code causing an extra redundant fallback fetch for root-like paths. #2214 (labeled chore) fixes the same slash-stripping in two call sites (buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls) and includes test-file updates, but does not touch shouldAttemptFallback, leaving that redundant-fallback behavior unfixed. #2215's diff does not show an equivalent change to buildDiscoveryUrls's separate inline slash-stripping copy, so that second call site's multi-trailing-slash handling from #2214 should be folded into #2215 before merge.
